standard.summary: 有 preserve_mask 时额外约束保留区域。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: With a preserve_mask present, adds a constraint on the region being kept.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 有 preserve_mask 时额外约束保留区域。0 表示不启用额外保留损失。

advanced_en.principle: When a preserve_mask is present, adds an extra constraint on preserved regions. 0 disables the extra preservation loss.
